items.lede: The theft of agents' personal information could present a major counterintelligence threat, where agents and their families are extorted into cooperating with a foreign government.
items.title: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI, stole agents’ and applicants’ data

items.lede: The ShinyHunters extortion gang claims it breached FBI systems using a new Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day vulnerability, gaining access to internal services and stealing sensitive data on employees and job applicants. [...]
items.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI hack, data theft in PeopleSoft zero-day breach
